questions: Should the function handle non-numeric columns (e.g., strings) by ignoring them, raising an error, or converting them?
What correlation method (e.g., Pearson, Spearman) should be used?
If a column has all identical values (zero variance), should it be included in the correlation matrix (resulting in NaN) or excluded?
Should the correlation matrix include only numeric columns that originally had no missing values, or should it drop rows with missing values across all columns first?
Is the input 'data' guaranteed to be a list of lists, or could it be other iterable types (e.g., tuple of tuples)?
Should the function validate that 'cols' length matches the number of columns in 'data'?
